$comment: The one source of truth for Constant Labs business facts: name, contact, hours, team, offers and prices. constantlabs.ai, websites.constantlabs.ai and seo.constantlabs.ai all build from this file, as do the schema and every llms.txt. Change a fact here and nowhere else. Published at https://constantlabs.ai/facts.json so answer engines can read it directly.

brand.name: Constant Labs
brand.description: Dubai software and AI studio. We build AI agents, websites, custom software and SEO systems for businesses in the UAE and the GCC, in Arabic and English.

licence.authority: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET)

currency.rule: Prices are set in AED. Saudi customers pay the same number in Saudi riyals (SAR), not converted. Everyone else sees USD, converted at the USD peg and rounded to the nearest 5.
